title: HHSRS — unsupported hazard: cosmetic crack proposed as structural collapse
why: A fine crack following a plasterboard joint with no displacement is not a structural-collapse hazard. Hazard 29 here is over-classification; none is the right answer.

room.name: Landing
room.note: Fine straight crack along a plasterboard joint in the ceiling, about 1.2m, no displacement, no sag, tape showing through. Dry.

transcripts: Landing ceiling, straight crack along a board joint, about a metre twenty, dead straight, you can see the tape. No sag, no displacement, dry.

must_not_happen.label: no structural-collapse hazard for a tape-line crack

reviewer_notes: Register: a hazard is proposed only where the evidence clearly engages it.
